# mimecast_dmarc_managed_domain (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast DMARC Analyzer managed domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_dmarc_managed_domain" "example" {
  domain          = "example.com"
  activity_status = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Managed domain name. Mimecast does not expose an update operation for this field.

### Optional

- `activity_status` (String) Managed-domain activity status.

### Read-Only

- `detected_status` (String) Detected-domain activity status.
- `dkim_delegation_id` (String) DKIM delegation record ID.
- `dkim_status` (String) DKIM DNS configuration status.
- `dmarc_delegation_id` (String) DMARC delegation record ID.
- `dmarc_policy` (String) Published DMARC policy.
- `dmarc_status` (String) DMARC DNS configuration status.
- `dns_a_records` (Attributes Set) A records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_a_records))
- `dns_aaaa_records` (Attributes Set) AAAA records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_aaaa_records))
- `dns_caa_records` (Attributes Set) CAA records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_caa_records))
- `dns_cname_records` (Attributes Set) CNAME records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_cname_records))
- `dns_dkim_records` (Attributes Set) DKIM records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_dkim_records))
- `dns_dmarc_records` (Attributes Set) DMARC records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_dmarc_records))
- `dns_dnskey_records` (Attributes Set) DNSKEY records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_dnskey_records))
- `dns_ds_records` (Attributes Set) DS records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_ds_records))
- `dns_mx_records` (Attributes Set) MX records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_mx_records))
- `dns_ns_records` (Attributes Set) NS records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_ns_records))
- `dns_ptr_records` (Attributes Set) PTR records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_ptr_records))
- `dns_soa_records` (Attributes Set) SOA records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_soa_records))
- `dns_srv_records` (Attributes Set) SRV records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_srv_records))
- `dns_txt_records` (Attributes Set) TXT records returned for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_txt_records))
- `id` (String) DMARC Analyzer managed-domain ID.
- `is_policy_inherited` (Boolean) Whether the DMARC policy is inherited from a parent domain.
- `spf_delegation_id` (String) SPF delegation record ID.
- `spf_status` (String) SPF DNS configuration status.
- `status` (String) Managed-domain lifecycle stage.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_dmarc_managed_domain.example managed-domain-id
```
